g.text: Accept refuses a dirty tree or open build escalations.
Nobody approves by eye. The checks decide.
Merge into local main. The page shows lead time by phase.
A check fails. Accept sends the slice back to build once, as a FIX task with frozen tests kept.
A second failure escalates. Nothing merges on a red check, and the owner stays on the branch.
